Matching `mori_core::language(source)` and returning `consumer.core(Err(error), false)` on `Err(error)` preserves the complete `mori_core::Error` (`code`, `message`, `offset`, `step`) for all `SourceCheckConsumer` callers (`mori check` in `check.rs`, `mori compile --static-check` in `compile.rs`, `mori fmt` in `format.rs`, and `mori lsp` in `lsp.rs`).

Replacing `.is_ok_and(...)` with `mori_core::language(&source).map_err(super::core_io::operation)? == "moriarty/2"` propagates the routing reader's complete `mori_core::Error` through `core_io::operation` (`mori::command`) before `mori_core::parse(&source)` is called.
